parsed.rationale: Both `MainActorNotificationMessageSequence` (line 129 of `MainActorMessage.swift`) and `AsyncNotificationMessageSequence` (line 103 of `AsyncMessage.swift`) are `type-alias-object` declarations in the same `Core` package. Despite sharing 3 structural slots, they carry semantically distinct names: one is explicitly scoped to `@MainActor` dispatch, the other is a general async notification sequence. Collapsing them would conflate actor-isolation semantics with unconstrained async semantics, which is a meaningful runtime distinction in Swift concurrency. No fields or signatures are listed, so there is insufficient evidence to assert the underlying aliased types are identical rather than merely structurally similar.
